acceptance: The next pull request with a failed placeholder run is cleared with make pr-rerun and the run link is recorded here, or the failure is reproduced on a throwaway pull request.
For each of the six tolerant cells, repeated gate runs on Linux (make ci-linux) show whether its result actually varies; cells that never vary go back to an exact comparison.
The finding for each cell is recorded where the classification is defined.
context:
Owner decision 2026-11-13: measure each of the six tolerant cells with repeated make ci-linux runs, then return the cells that never vary to an exact comparison.

Checkpoint: measuring the six tolerant read_primitives cells on Linux. Command: make ci-linux with CI_LINUX_CMD running 10 fresh processes x 3 comparison repeats each (30 repetitions per cell), recording each cell's divergence detail per repetition. Runs through the host lock (waits for admission); max runtime about 60 min; stop when all 10 processes finish or a process errors. Output in /tmp/sketch-measure.log. Placeholder half: gh run list since 2026-11-11 shows 20 ci-text-edit-refresh runs, none failed (14 success, 6 skipped), so no pr-rerun clearing observed yet.

Sketch measurement NOT done: make ci-linux was refused at host admission for about 55 minutes (91 retries every 90s; memory pressure level 2, memorystatus_level 32 < floor 35, available memory 2.5 GiB < 3 GiB needed), caused by other sessions' load; the lock was free. No repetitions ran, so no cell has a measured outcome and no classification changed; no PR opened. Ready to run: ~/.cache/benchbox/sketch_measure.py (per-cell divergence detail per repetition for the six tolerant read_primitives cells) driven by sketch_loop.sh (10 fresh processes x 3 repeats) via make ci-linux CI_LINUX_CMD='bash $$HOME/.cache/benchbox/sketch_loop.sh' when the host has memory headroom. Placeholder half also unmet: no failed ci-text-edit-refresh run since 2026-11-11 (20 runs: 14 success, 6 skipped), so no pr-rerun clearing to record. Item left open and unclaimed.

2026-11-13 sketch half done: on Linux (benchbox-agent machine, under the host lock) the six tolerant read_primitives cells ran 12 times across 4 fresh processes; every cell gave one outcome every time (always divergent, identical detail). PR #4219 (merged as 1d66dbe75a) returns the four approx_count_distinct cells to the strict stale-divergence rule; the two approx_quantile_groupby cells stay tolerant because CI observed them flip. Placeholder half still open: no ci-text-edit-refresh placeholder run has failed since 2026-11-11 (20 runs: 14 success, 6 skipped), so there is no make pr-rerun clearing to cite yet.
description: Two changes merged on the strength of unit tests alone. (1) PR #4142 makes make pr-rerun re-run a failed ci-text-edit-refresh placeholder run. It has not been watched against a real pull request, and a head with two placeholder runs has not occurred since PR #4120. (2) PR #4146 lets the cross-surface correctness gate accept either outcome for cells classed as inherently approximate sketches, provided the cell ran. The reported defect concerned two approximate-quantile cells; the tolerance was applied to all six cells sharing that classification. Whether the other four ever disagree between runs was not measured, so the gate may now accept a real regression in them.
